decision: START_LOG D5 (OPERATOR DECISIONS 2026-10-14): one Operator-attended batched session, one launch per app, dialogs off, gamma Color Setting read and restored by the scripts
naming: <case_id>__<variant>.<ext> (non [A-Za-z0-9_.+-] characters become underscores); every app writes manifest.json (app version, locale, entries with bits/profile/params, errors, state before/after) and errors.log; Photoshop also writes inputs/ (the generated fixtures)

apps.dialogs_off: app.displayDialogs = DialogModes.NO (set at start, restored in finally); executeAction calls pass DialogModes.NO

operator_launch.menu: File > Scripts > Browse... then pick the file
operator_launch.command_line: PowerShell COM (UNVERIFIED for 2026): $ps = New-Object -ComObject Photoshop.Application; $ps.DoJavaScriptFile('<full path to hsk_oracle_photoshop.jsx>')  (ProgID Photoshop.Application is registered on this host)

preconditions: No Photoshop document open (script aborts otherwise).

Edit > Color Settings: the active setting must be a NAMED preset (not 'Custom'); a second preset named HSK-gamma-1.0 (More Options > Blend RGB Colors Using Gamma, 1.00) must exist, else only PS-G01 is skipped.
global_settings_touched: app.colorSettings (name only; Blend RGB Colors Using Gamma has no verified scripting path)
restore_steps: Script reads app.displayDialogs, app.preferences.rulerUnits and app.colorSettings (name) before touching anything.

Gamma pass (PS-G01) sets app.colorSettings = 'HSK-gamma-1.0' (a preset the Operator saved), runs 29 exports, then the finally block re-applies the saved name and writes manifest state.colorSettings_after and state.restore_checked.
finally also restores rulerUnits and displayDialogs and closes every document the script opened (fixtures included).
apps.control_files: control/ps_only.txt (one case id per line = run only those)
